source: 관공서의 공휴일에 관한 규정 + 우주항공청 2026년 월력요항 (cross-checked; originally Nager.Date)

metadata.note: Matches the official 2026 월력요항 (3·1절 대체 3/2, 부처님오신날 대체 5/25, 광복절 대체 8/17, 개천절 대체 10/5; 추석 9/24-26, no substitute because 9/26 is a Saturday; 9/28 NOT a holiday). 6/3 = 제9회 전국동시지방선거 (election day is a 관공서 공휴일). 제헌절 7/17 re-designated by the 규정 amendment (국무회의 2026-04-28, effective 2026-05-11). UNVERIFIED: whether government offices were closed on 노동절 2026-05-01, which preceded the amendment's effective date — past date, no effect on future deadlines.
